name: Rhubarb Cake
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors

ingredients.item: 1 cup sour milk or cultured buttermilk

steps: Cream the brown sugar and butter until fluffy. Beat in the egg and salt.
Stir in the milk, baking soda, vanilla, and flour. Once blended, add the rhubarb and stir until mixed in.
Pour batter into greased 9x13-inch pan. Combine the ¼ cup sugar and cinnamon, then sprinkle on top of the batter.

culture.text: Cake is a baker's confectionery made by combining flour with a liquid, a fat or both, and usually with a leavening agent. Cakes are usually baked, but can be griddled. In their oldest forms, cakes were modifications of bread, but cakes now cover a wide range of preparations that can be simple or elaborate and which share features with other desserts such as pastries, meringues, custards, and pies.
